CATEGORY: a series of actions: last one with 了 (Coherence: temporality)
definition: When narrating a series of actions, use the aspect marking to organize the sequence; normally the final completed action takes 了.

HER NOTES IN THIS CATEGORY (0 distinct):
(none)

HER CORRECTIONS (1 of 1):
[shennong_samples#25/f1/p0/k0/e0] 他走了很远的路去[-了]学哪些植物可以入药

output.rule: In a series of actions, normally put 了completed on the final completed action, not on an earlier action that leads to the next one.
output.explanation_template: <wrong> → <correct>: <action> leads to the next action, so do not use 了completed here; normally the final completed action takes 了.

examples.explanation: 他走了很远的路去学哪些植物可以入药 → 他走很远的路去学哪些植物可以入药: 走 leads to 去学, so do not use 了completed on 走.

output.not_an_error: Do not apply this rule when the sentence is not narrating a series of actions.
